# Third-party assets (self-hosted)

The portal makes no request to external services: these files are served with it.

| File | Project | Version | License |
|---|---|---|---|
| `vue.global.prod.js` | [Vue.js](https://vuejs.org/) | 3.5.43 | MIT |
| `fonts/` (Roboto, latin + latin-ext) | [Roboto](https://fonts.google.com/specimen/Roboto) | Google Fonts | SIL Open Font License 1.1 |
| `fonts/` (Material Icons) | [Material Icons](https://fonts.google.com/icons) | Google Fonts | Apache License 2.0 |
| `codemirror/` (core + SQL mode) | [CodeMirror 5](https://codemirror.net/5/) | 5.65.18 | MIT |
| `qrcode-generator/qrcode.js` (QR code of the authenticator apps) | [qrcode-generator](https://github.com/kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator) (Kazuhiko Arase, npm `qrcode-generator`) | 1.4.4 | MIT (header of the file) |

To upgrade Vue, download `https://unpkg.com/vue@<version>/dist/vue.global.prod.js` here and
update this table.
